name: Winterbotham Trust Company
brand_truth: A family name with two centuries of public service behind it, now a Nassau bank and trust house built on one idea: trust is built over time.
buyer: International families, entrepreneurs, fund managers and financial institutions, and their advisers doing due diligence on desktop.

design.signature: Live local-time strip for six offices feeding an office detail panel with ticking clock; 'I am...' service finder; heritage hairline timeline

current_site_findings: Homepage opens with a tariff-revision notice before saying who Winterbotham is.
All six homepage service icons share the alt text 'Trust'.
The History portrait file of Rev. William Winterbotham is labelled 'Geoffrey Hooper' in its alt text.
No meta description; generic title without Nassau or The Bahamas.
No email on the contact page; only a reCAPTCHA form.
pitch_line: Your clients in Montevideo and Hong Kong judge you in ten seconds on your website, and right now it opens with a tariff notice and a 2023 footer; this concept opens with your regulator, your Nassau desk and the time in all six of your offices.
assumptions: Record lists Nassau / Freeport; no Freeport office found, concept shows Nassau head office only
Audience mapping in the 'I am...' finder (which services apply to whom) is our editorial grouping of their published services
notes: Has a working site (record said no own site). Large regulated group; pitch is a front-door redesign, likely needs a decision-maker contact rather than a walk-in. Their site photos are generic lifestyle images and were not used. No email sourced; consultation is phone-led. Office clocks show local time only (no opening hours claimed).
